thread.title: Dow Today Spikes 500 Points On Apple, Boeing, The Fed | Investor's Business Daily

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Dow Today Spikes 500 Points On Apple, Boeing, The Fed | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Key market indexes stormed to session highs heading into the last hour of trade, after the Fed left its key interest rate unchanged . The Dow today at one point leapt more than 500 points, boosted by strong earnings.
X The Dow Jones Industrial Average rallied 2.1%, the Nasdaq soared 2% and the S&P 500 advanced 1.9%. Small caps lagged slightly with the Russell 2000 up 1%. Volume was tracking higher on both the NYSE and Nasdaq vs. the same time Tuesday.
The Dow today popped above its 200-day moving average for the first time since Dec. 4, thanks to big moves by blue chips Boeing ( BA ), Apple ( AAPL ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ).
Boeing soared 7%, coasting into a buy zone, on a Q4 upside earnings surprise . Shares flew past a 373.80 buy point of a double-bottom base , as well as an earlier handle entry of 367.42.
The jet maker's profit rose 14% to $5.48 a share, vs. consensus estimates for a 5.8% drop. Revenue increased 11.7% to $28.34 billion, above views for $26.65 billion. Boeing said it expects to boost commercial aircraft deliveries this year at double last year's pace.
Apple gapped up and surged 7% to its best level in six weeks. It touched its 50-day line for the first time since Nov. 1. At 33% off its high, the stock still has a long ways to go before a potential buy point emerges.
After the close Tuesday, the iPhone maker reported fiscal Q1 results that narrowly topped earnings and sales views. Profit rose 7% year over year; revenue fell 5%. Apple offered current-quarter sales guidance of $55 billion to $59 billion. The $57 billion midpoint is below Wall Street forecasts for $59 billion.
Microsoft Boosts Dow Today Microsoft added 3%, ahead of its quarterly results due after the close today. Shares, which fell below the 50-day and 200-day average Tuesday, recovered both lines. The stock has added a handle to a cup base . That makes the proper buy point 108, or a dime above the handle's high. Analysts expect earnings to rise 14% to $1.09 a share on a 12% sales bump to $32.5 billion.
Energy, internet retail and telecom consumer products — fueled by Apple's big move — led the upside among sector gainers.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Over in the IBD 50 , Medpace Holdings ( MEDP ) vaulted 6% to clear a 62.23 buy point of a cup with handle base. ServiceNow ( NOW ), which leapt 5%, broke out past a handle entry at 192.89. The Leaderboard member reports earnings after the close. Analysts expect EPS to surge 83% to 64 cents.
Medpace is a new member of IBD Swing Trader .
Among other IBD 50 stocks on the rise, Trade Desk ( TTD ), CyberArk Software ( CYBR ) and Kirkland Lake Gold ( KL ) added more than 3% each. Only four stocks weren't taking part in the broad advance.
Kirkland Gold is highlighted in today's IBD Stock Of The Day column .
The Innovator IBD 50 ETF ( FFTY ) rose as much as 1.7% in the stock market today . FFTY fell mildly in 2018 following a 34% boost in 2017.
